question:
Read the given statements carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the statements.

**Statements:**

(i) Ram is an artist.

(ii) Artists are beautiful.

options.text: Conclusion 1: All beautiful persons are artists.
Conclusion 4: Beautiful persons are not artists.
